matchup.title: The matchup
items: Two rosters frame the arena. The **left sidebar** (the "Fighter") ranks characters by total lines spoken — leads float up. Pick one, and the **right roster** (the "Target") re-ranks by how much each character *shares scenes* with that fighter: their closest partners rise, tinted and counted.
The **duo header** shows both portraits — click either to open its character page. Between them, the **⚔** carries a sort toggle that flips the spine between oldest- and newest-first.
The **spine** below runs every scene the pair shares, in reading order. If they never appear together it says so — pick a different pair.

layers.title: Layers
items: **Presence** — back-to-back dialogue bars per scene (A ◀ cell ▶ B): who carries each shared scene.
**Chapters** — band the spine by chapter (folder), read from your story tree.
**Warmth** — replace the spine with the pair's warmth trajectory, on a Warm↔Cold axis.
**Events** — relationship shift markers flanking each scene; click one for the detail.
**Irony** — dramatic-irony bands from custody topics: where the reader knows what a fighter doesn't, the band sits on the *unknowing* side. Summoned, not ambient — off by default.

reading.title: Reading it
items: A roster row's **tint and trailing number** are its metric — total lines for the left, lines-shared-with-the-fighter for the right. The selected row keeps its tint and gains a glow.
The rail spans the **active timeline's** scenes in its reading order — the same set every other rail shows, not the whole universe.
The declared bond (how the author describes the relationship) isn't shown here — it lives on each character's page, a click away via the portraits.
